symptom: Deep-loop command runs stall at iteration 1 with no output across sessions.
claim: A snapshot lock is blocking the orchestrator before it can record progress.
evidence: Leaf executor/model flags are set, but no completed iteration appears and no stream trace has been captured.
label: reproduce

symptom: Starting Code Mode leaves many stdio child processes after the session ends; authorization prompts recur every few minutes without user action.
claim: Manual discovery leaves each stdio transport open, and exit abandons them instead of closing clients.
evidence: A process census finds children for manuals never invoked; no shutdown trace shows whether transports receive close.
label: read_code

symptom: With a spaced checkout path and NODE_PRESERVE_SYMLINKS=1, deep-loop exits before recording iteration 1 with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for loop-lock.js.
claim: The worktree is missing loop-lock.js.
evidence: The failure appears only through the tsx re-exec path on a spaced checkout; no file inventory from that checkout has been captured.
label: reproduce

symptom: Launcher-lease suite cleanup leaves detached context-server stubs after tests; four cleanup assertions fail.
claim: Default daemon re-election releases the child on SIGTERM instead of killing it.
evidence: Failures cluster where launcher termination is followed by temp-workspace removal; the adoption case also times out.
label: run_test

symptom: The local transformer fallback loads its model but returns no vector; an integration call reports that pipeline is not a function.
claim: Dynamic import exposes pipeline under default because the package exports CommonJS.
evidence: The runtime sees a loaded transformer package but no embedding vector; its export shape has not been logged.
label: read_code

symptom: During heavy indexing, the daemon occasionally SIGBUSes in walIndexReadHdr with page-in error 22.
claim: The vector-shard attach path is corrupting the main database and causing the fault.
evidence: Crashes are intermittent around shard activity; no integrity check or journal-mode comparison has been captured.
label: reproduce

symptom: After a parent CLI is hard-killed, the Code Mode server remains under PID 1 and new bridge probes time out.
claim: The server lacks a session-end handler or parent-death check.
evidence: A process census finds survivors after the parent disappears, but shutdown signals have not been tested separately.
label: reproduce

symptom: The cli-jev hub misses plain requests such as ask Jev for a probability, though its metadata advertises that phrasing.
claim: The router only activates when Jev appears with a subcommand or alias.
evidence: An explicit jev score activates, while plain advertised phrasing misses; the router rules have not been inspected.
label: read_code

symptom: The doctor install command resolves a decommissioned server with npx, then warns it is not wired into configuration.
claim: Cached npx metadata is making the current server configuration look absent.
evidence: Output shows package resolution followed by missing-wiring warnings; no clean-cache run or command-source review has been done.
label: reproduce

symptom: The advisor directive block is missing in slower sessions across several runtimes, though some requests show it.
claim: A downstream adapter drops the block after the hook returns while flushing diagnostics.
evidence: Missing outputs correlate with slower starts, and current records do not identify elapsed time or delivered bytes.
label: instrument

symptom: A repeated same-message advisor block appears twice when message and lifecycle deduplication are both enabled.
claim: Lifecycle reduction changes the block before the dedup hash, so the repeated message hashes differently.
evidence: Duplication disappears when either option is off; intermediate hashed content is unavailable.
label: run_test

symptom: edit_lines refuses a patch by one line near EOF, reporting an insertion or deletion mismatch.
claim: The checker wrongly counts the final empty line and should accept a count one lower.
evidence: The read output, refusal, and file all end with a newline; no exact line-number comparison has been reviewed.
label: run_test

symptom: progressive-validate --json emits invalid JSON when validation is skipped, and audits count skipped folders as passes.
claim: The skip notice is mixed into JSON output and callers lack a skipped status.
evidence: The command parses when validation is on, while only the skipped case fails downstream parsing; stream handling has not been checked.
label: read_code

symptom: Sandbox teardown sometimes leaves directories behind, and generation state changes during cleanup.
claim: The advisor ignores teardown signals, so cleanup needs to force-kill it.
evidence: A watched crash run shows the generation file changing before exit; open-file ownership at removal time was not recorded.
label: instrument

symptom: Generated changelog frontmatter breaks when a title contains quotes, and a summary containing $& is shortened.
claim: The renderer inserts unescaped values into the output and rescans replacement text.
evidence: Ordinary title and summary values render cleanly; the unusual-character cases fail, but the template path has not been isolated.
label: reproduce

symptom: A real cited file is reported unresolved when AC citations are comma- or semicolon-separated.
claim: The citation splitter leaves the delimiter attached to the next path.
evidence: Single-path citations pass and joined paths fail; the split tokens have not been inspected.
label: run_test

symptom: An unfamiliar non-README receives a README verdict without a warning.
claim: The extension classifier marks every Markdown file as a README before specific rules run.
evidence: Known README and skill documents validate, but the unfamiliar file's type decision is not surfaced.
label: read_code

symptom: A phase-parent goal sent in chat contains template author instructions and is nearly 3,000 characters long.
claim: The chat client adds the template guidance after serialization because its message limit truncates the goal incorrectly.
evidence: The visible draft is long and includes author-facing text; no emitted payload has been compared with the goal slice meant for chat.
label: reproduce

symptom: Document validation rejects AGENTS.md and a read-only surface packet for missing standard sections.
claim: The validator applies ordinary skill-section requirements to files with different roles.
evidence: Both errors cite standard skill sections while comparable authored skills pass; no classification trace is available.
label: read_code

symptom: The cli-pi playbook validator reports a scenario-count mismatch.
claim: The validator's directory walk skips a hidden nested scenario folder.
evidence: The overview count differs from the visible index and folders; no recursive inventory has been compared with the validator.
label: reproduce

symptom: A fresh worktree skips dependency installation, and parent-skill-check cannot load @spec-kit/shared for sk-doc.
claim: The dependency detector ignores @spec-kit links, so a link-only package looks dependency-free.
evidence: Packages with ordinary dependencies provision correctly; the link-only package fails in new worktrees, but detector output is unavailable.
label: run_test

symptom: The shell hook-flags reader disagrees with Node and Python about a value containing internal spaces.
claim: The shell parser removes every space inside a flag value.
evidence: Cross-reader checks disagree on a spaced value, but the shell reader's normalized result has not been printed.
label: run_test

symptom: A routing evaluation flags a flowchart-only prompt because its gold record expects chart and diagram modes.
claim: The router is missing chart mode for generic flowchart requests.
evidence: The prompt names flowcharts but no chart; one gold record expects two modes, and no live route result has been captured.
label: reproduce

symptom: CI stops before its test suites at the AST import-policy check for the level-contract fallback test.
claim: The test's resolver import is valid but missing from the policy allowlist.
evidence: Two sibling tests use the same import and appear to pass; the target test's policy entry has not been checked.
label: read_code

symptom: The rule-canary sync check fails on every push and its self-test reports a missing file.
claim: The canary still references removed CLAUDE.md instead of AGENTS.md.
evidence: CLAUDE.md was removed and AGENTS.md remains, but the canary's target list has not been compared with current files.
label: read_code

symptom: Changelog rewrites repeatedly pass the fact check but are returned from review for missing timing or actor details.
claim: The driver is using a stale fact-check brief from an earlier run.
evidence: Review comments recur despite each fact-check pass; no run record identifies which brief was used.
label: read_code

symptom: The drift guard flags six recorded cli-jev probe scripts even though bash -n passes.
claim: The scripts use set -u without pipefail, contrary to the shell standard.
evidence: All six parse and the guard points to shell-safety flags; their pipeline behavior has not been inspected.
label: read_code

symptom: A push from a linked worktree fails the track-root gate because it cannot read the pushed commit.
claim: Inherited GIT_DIR without GIT_WORK_TREE makes git -C resolve the wrong repository root.
evidence: The hook succeeds from the main checkout and fails from a linked worktree; its process environment has not been captured.
label: instrument

symptom: Codex runs repository hooks twice per event, and the hooks also run in sessions started outside the checkout.
claim: Codex retries each event after a handler timeout, causing duplicate execution.
evidence: Both global and checkout hook configuration paths exist; event logs do not identify which file registered each call.
label: instrument

symptom: The stale-build upgrade test fails in a fresh clone but passes in a long-lived checkout.
claim: The test edits the wrong validator path after a clean install, so stale source never reaches the runner.
evidence: The fresh clone lacks runtime-local node_modules while the old checkout has it; the test's copied tree has not been inspected.
label: reproduce

symptom: Recursive validation passes a numbered phase folder with no spec.md or description.json.
claim: The traversal skips the child because it has neither packet marker file.
evidence: Other phase children produce validation reports, but there is no result record for the empty folder.
label: run_test

symptom: The pre-push gate rejects main after cli-jev packet 003 is merged.
claim: The cli-jev track root does not list packet 003 as a child.
evidence: The folder exists and the gate reports a registration mismatch; the track-root entry has not been inspected.
label: read_code

symptom: Deep command contract rendering and drift checks fail after a rollout-mode change.
claim: A prior evidence reconciliation demoted command modes and left their compiled digests stale.
evidence: Three contracts fail in one run, but their source-mode values and recorded digests have not been compared.
label: read_code

symptom: Stale-owner recovery starts a second daemon while the old server still responds to a socket probe.
claim: The reclaim path reaps and respawns before checking whether the warm daemon can be adopted.
evidence: A new PID appears after owner exit, but no process-to-database ownership trace has been captured.
label: instrument

symptom: A blocked commit message identifies the failed gate but gives no route to proceed.
claim: The hook's block message omits the supported one-command bypass.
evidence: The refusal is consistent across two hook families; their message templates and bypass parsing have not been compared.
label: read_code

symptom: With SPECKIT_SKIP_VALIDATION enabled, validate.sh --json prints nothing and the pre-commit metadata gate refuses staged spec docs.
claim: Validation exits before parsing arguments or producing a skipped JSON report.
evidence: The metadata gate reads the packet as unavailable only with the switch enabled; stdout from the failing invocation was not saved.
label: run_test
